# CODEOWNERS Shadow Checker

> Free tool: paste your CODEOWNERS file and your repo's file list to see exactly which earlier, more specific rules a later, broader rule silently overrides -- GitHub's own last-match-wins resolution, the most common way a CODEOWNERS file quietly stops reviewing what you think it reviews. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## What it reports

- Shadowed rules: earlier rules a later, broader rule overrides for every listed file (last match wins).
- Redundant rules: shadowed only by rules naming the same owners (a notice: no file loses a reviewer).
- Pattern matching tested against `git check-ignore` itself on generated patterns, apart from GitHub's documented exceptions.
- Unmatched rules (matched none of the listed files) and uncovered files (no rule at all).
- Syntax errors: owners that are not @user, @org/team or an email, and the gitignore syntax GitHub says does not work in CODEOWNERS (`!` negation, `[ ]` ranges, `\#` escapes).
